messages.subject: Scheduled maintenance: DMS and document services this weekend
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The firm's document management system (NetDocs) and associated print/scan services will be unavailable from 22:00 Saturday 20 September to 06:00 Sunday 21 September for scheduled maintenance. Please ensure any documents in progress are checked in before Saturday evening. Email will not be affected.

Thank you,
IT Helpdesk | Whitfield Carter LLP
